handoverLog.doing: Sesi A selesai (tahap 0–4). Pre-flight lolos tanpa blocker. Style PAPERWORLD, engine Remotion + R3F 3D (kit paperworld: Stage/Cut/ShearPop/PaperTree/PaperHill/PaperCharacter + GLB nyata diberi paperFace). Alternatif ditolak: CHRONICLE (2D material datar), HD2D, ISLAMICDOCUMENTARY (juri 3,67). Naskah 198 kata (est. 79–88 dtk), 7 chapter c01–c07, teks VO polos di work/vo.txt (spoken: Thuwa→Tuwa, Al-Quran→Al Quran, brand "Audira"). Storyboard 8 set: S1 api titik di lereng malam, S2 perkemahan+ternak (sheep/goat/camel GLB, tenda), S3 pendakian+lentera, S4 pohon bercahaya+terompah (Thuwa), S5 tongkat→ular kertas, S6 makro tangan bercahaya + stempel 9 MUKJIZAT, S7 fajar+istana Mesir+siluet Harun (riser+impact), S8 wide outro + papan AUDIRA QISSAH. Adab: Musa tanpa wajah bertudung dari belakang, panggilan Allah hanya cahaya pohon + pita ayat, Firaun tidak digambar. Memori PAPERWORLD: DOCUMENTARY_WARM, exposure 0.9–1.0 (latar malam), envIntensity 0.25, AO on, bayangan panjang searah api, FG DOF blur ~9px, haze hanya BG/MG, figur berlipatan (bukan kerucut halus), variasi skala shot, label ≥40px; gold acuan kits/paperworld/gold/short-baru-11-23-EP18. Cover topik BELUM dirender (butuh scaffold).
handoverLog.next: Sesi B tahap 5: scaffold Remotion di <EP>/project (audira_init_motion_project / new-project.mjs --kit=paperworld), check-env + smoke, render cover-topic.png (frame hook S1) ke style/. Tahap 6: audira_generate_voiceover dari work/vo.txt (Galang 04b567df…, id) lalu npm run vo, kunci timing. Tahap 7: multi-scene 8 set sesuai STORYBOARD, HUD pita ayat, AudiraSignature seed kisah-islam-EP45, npm run sfx. Tahap 8: draft/THEME_CHECK.md + contact sheet 540×960 + audit:visual + record_score self lalu juri buta (maks 2 putaran). Render berat lewat audira_render_batch (4 sesi lain render paralel di PC sama). Kerja HANYA di folder EP45, jangan commit.
